items.title: Extending AWS DevOps Agent with Skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers, Custom Agents and Connectors
items.summary: AWS DevOps Agent investigates incidents, traces problems from code to cloud, and analyzes Amazon CloudWatch, AWS CloudTrail, and third-party observability tools out of the box. But every operations team carries knowledge the agent cannot reach through generic reasoning: the order you check things in when, for example, an Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) task won’t […]
